turns: add the streaks command described in docs/streaks.md. verify it.

edge_sources.boundary: List the members whose streak is at least N days
edge_sources.empty: When nobody is listed, including when the log is empty, print `no streaks`.
edge_sources.ties: Members with equal streaks keep the order of their first line in the log.
edge_sources.casefold: Two names belong to the same member when they are equal under Unicode case folding.
edge_sources.same-day: A day counts once however many runs the member logged on it.
edge_sources.out-of-order: Late entries get appended to the end of the file, so the log is not always in date order.
